## About This Site

This website is a portfolio of my academic and professional work, maintained throughout my time at 
Lawrence University. It showcases research projects, internship experiences, and class projects 
from my studies in Business Analytics and Data Science.

## Courses & Academic Work

One highlight of my academic journey is contributing to the development of **BUEN 240: Business 
Ethnography** a course I helped design as part of a LURF (Lawrence University Research Fellowship) 
project in Summer 2025 alongside Faith Onukaogu '26 and Prof. Carla Daughtry. The course is now 
being offered at Lawrence University and bridges anthropological research methods with real-world 
business applications.

## Skills

- **Analytics & Data:** R, Python, Excel (Solver, PivotTables, VBA), Power BI
- **Business:** Market research, competitive analysis, supply chain coordination, brand strategy
- **Tools:** Shiny, ggplot2, Canva, Microsoft Office Suite
